what: an explicit 0 passed to export.py --duration, export.py --pad-blur, caption.py --font-size, caption.py --emoji-scale and graphics.py --emoji-scale was quietly overridden or replaced with a default or clamped value instead of being refused
escaped: edge-value test sweep reported 0 as RAN because 0 was treated as falsy or clamped rather than validated against positive bounds
mechanism: added explicit > 0 validation guards to export.py, caption.py and graphics.py, and documented 1..2000 in caption font-size help so runner option bounds checking catches 0
